description: We are WAID, a team of ambitious young women passionate about coding, technology, innovation and problem-solving. We are participating in NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, explore creative ways to combine programming and space science.
summary:
LUNA BASE – Beyond Survival is an interactive lunar survival and exploration simulator developed by W.A.I.D. (Women in AI Development). Our project introduces players to the challenges of establishing and maintaining a human presence on the Moon through an educational gaming experience.

Players take on the role of lunar explorers, completing missions, performing activities, managing essential resources such as oxygen, water, food and electricity, and responding to simulated emergencies. They must also complete quizzes to test their knowledge and progress through different mission stages.

We developed the application using Python and Streamlit, with HTML, CSS and JavaScript powering our interactive lunar environment and VR-style viewing experience.

Our goal is to make lunar science and space exploration more engaging and accessible while encouraging critical thinking, problem-solving and interest in future space missions.
details:
LUNA BASE – Beyond Survival is an interactive lunar survival and exploration game designed to educate players about the challenges of establishing and maintaining human life on the Moon.

Players take on the role of a lunar explorer and progress through different missions by completing assigned activities, managing essential resources such as oxygen, water, food, electricity and crew health, and responding to unexpected emergencies. Each mission introduces different challenges and requires players to make decisions that affect their survival and mission progress. Players also complete quizzes to test their knowledge of lunar science and exploration.

The project was developed using Python and Streamlit for the main application, together with HTML, CSS and JavaScript for the interactive lunar simulation. We also incorporated background music and VR-style viewing features to create a more immersive experience.

Our creativity lies in combining educational content with interactive gameplay, allowing players to learn through simulated experiences rather than simply reading information.

The intended impact is to increase awareness and interest in lunar exploration, space science and the challenges astronauts may encounter during future Moon missions.
